messages.subject: 9 years and 896 unmarked subscribers
parts:
Dear unmarked group,

  We did a bit of analysis of the unmarked users group and find 896 users subscribed to the email list and the growth in subscribers is shown in the attached histogram. We seem to be adding about 10-15 new subscribers per month.

  Just a reminder that we're always looking for people who want to get involved at some level. Novice R programmers can get involved by testing code and improving documentation.  Advanced programmers can write some good code!  Anyone can help by answering queries on the unmarked list.  We continue to advance unmarked at a very slow pace due to life and career commitments (and no funding). We recently reached out to Chris Rota and hopefully with his help we can bring online some functionality for multi-species occupancy models next year. Thanks to Chris Sutherland we have some decent documentation for the occupancy models with false positives which will be in the next update of unmarked, probably this winter. We still hope to extend the pcountOpen functionality to include distance sampling and multinomial sampling protocols, if we can finish AHM volume 2 this winter.  And thanks to Marc Mazerolle for supporting unmarked in his AICcmodavg package.

 Thanks for using unmarked and being involved!
regards,
andy
